properties.warning_message: Thunder shower with strong wind is likely to occur at isolated places over Ballari, Bidar, Chikkamagaluru, Dakshina Kannada, Kodagu, Shivamogga, Tumakuru, Udupi, Uttara Kannada districts in next 3 hours. Source :- IMD Bengaluru
